sections.title: Bloodrush and Secrets
sections.subtitle: Bloodrush with the healer and the Archer
lines: In the clear your main job is to bloodrush with the healer and the Archer.
Once you finish br, do the secrets outside of blood room (target around 4-6).
Return to the blood room.
Swap to your lcm armor and bloodcamp.

sections.title: Left Crystal
sections.subtitle: Place the left crystal instantly, then dps Maxor
lines: Mage is the Left crystal in the maxor phase.
When the boss starts swap to your spring boots.
Pickup the crystal and wait on the pad to instantly place it.
Grab the 2nd crystal and place it.
Either leap to the tank or run over to maxor.
Spam left click with your chim hyp to enrange and dps maxor.
Help the archer to instantly kill maxor.
Leap down to the bers for storm.

sections.title: Storm: Pad and Kill
sections.subtitle: Hit Storm at 40.05 or 41.05 to kill at yellow
lines: Run to the purple pad, clear it and set it up so it is one below the top position.
Leap to the archer and kill all remaining archers around.
Mana drain during the end of the lightning.
Leap to the tank to crush the purple pad.
Leap to the healer after you hit storm once.
Run to the back of the platform without jumping or crouching.
Spam left click on storm to keep agro.
Time a hit on storm at 40.05 or 41.05 (depending on your archers kill time), to instantly kill storm at yellow.

sections.title: S1: Superbounce to 2nd Dev
sections.subtitle: Enter at 3.1, soul sand superbounce to 2nd dev
lines: Mage's role in terms is: bl i2 ee2 / 2 / core / recore.
When Storm is over leap to the healer and setswap to your terms set.
Move to the levers and spam click the lever waiting for the section to start.
Bonzo to the 2nd lever.
Blow the gate and premine it while you wait for the 3 tick.
Enter at 3.1 and run left placing a soul sand below you to superbounce you straight to the 2nd dev.
Click the device then face forward.
Wait for everyone to leap to you.

sections.title: S2: Flick and Core
sections.subtitle: Flick 90 degrees, do terminal 2, dig into core
lines: Flick 90 degrees and run off the platform landing straight at 2.
Do the 2nd terminal.
Dig into the wall in front of you to walk through core as shown.

sections.title: S3: Wait and Swap
sections.subtitle: Wait on the carpet, swap to storm armor and gdrag
lines: Run out the other side of the gold blocks.
Wait on the carpet for everyone to leap to you.
Swap to your storm armor and gdrag now.

sections.title: S4: Rag and Mineout
sections.subtitle: Dig into core, pop rag, mine out the 2x2
lines: Dig back into core when everyone leaps to you.
Pop your rag.
Mineout the 2x2 to the right side as shown.

sections.title: Orbs then Hit Goldor
sections.subtitle: Run out fast and hit Goldor asap
lines: Spam place orbs when the archer leaps to mana drain for them.
When the Goldor phase starts, run out as fast as possible.
Try to hit Goldor as soon as possible.

sections.title: Prefire and Spam Necron
sections.subtitle: Spam click Necron back to mid asap
lines: Leap to the healer and begin to prefire hitting necron with your chim hyp (venomous stacks).
Run to the front and center of the platform when necron drops you down.
Spam left click to send him back to mid as soon as possible.
Continue to spam click him throughout all the phases.

sections.title: Blue Relic
sections.subtitle: Leap to the bers and tap a to place blue relic
lines: Swap to black cat and a cow hat, and spam click.
Immediately leap to the bers as soon as possible.
Tap a to place the blue relic.

sections.title: Dragons: Rag and Debuff
sections.subtitle: Rag on 2nd dialogue, run to your split dragon
lines: Stand middle after placing your relic.
Swap in your last breath, ice spray wand, and twilight arrow poison.
Use your rag axe on the wither kings 2nd dialogue ("I no longer wish to fight, but I know that will not stop you").
Run to your split dragon as soon as possible and begin to debuff like normal.
Rag before drags 3 and 5.
Debuff like normal on dragon 4, except instead of ice spraying focus on getting a 1t first hit in order to proc lethality as fast as possible.
